content:
maria: Quick kudos — huge thanks to @jun and @ops-team for staying late to get the EU demo green. You two literally saved the day. :raised_hands:
jun: aw thanks! felt like defusing a bomb at 11pm 😂
lina: also, shoutout to @theo for the last-minute config fix. cookies incoming tomorrow 🍪
theo: I baked them! vegan + oat. label: 'for busy infra heroes'
kofi: :clap: everyone did great. customer follow-up said 'impressed by the stability' — passing to sales.
priya: @maria can we get a tiny note in the weekly update? deserve public kudos.
maria: yep I'll put a 2-line shoutout in Friday update. tagging @everyone? maybe too much :grin: (:+1: reaction by jun)
ops-bot: Deploybot: Successful rollback to stable at 2026-03-22T03:12Z — auto-tagged #oncall: @jun
jun: small PSA — if you touch the ingress rules please ping #eng-sre. learned that the hard way 😅
lina: raising a low-effort thank-you reward: cookies on me in kitchen at 10am. who's in?
theo: count me in. also windows of time for pickup? I'll bring extra napkins.
maria: :thumbsup: see you there, and extra thanks again. team deserves it.
